integrity: Full symbolic Gram-matrix inversion, independent exact rank-two conditional integration, exact nonnegative spectral-deficit formulas and same-model review; no claim of independent certification. The moment integration calculus is established literature.
scientific_limitations: For real first matrix coefficients of full Haar O(n) orthonormal k-frames, n>=3, 1<=k<=n, sixth moments only; no assertions for complex coefficients, SO(n), smaller n or other moment orders.
title: Sharp sixth moments and spectral rigidity of Haar-orthogonal matrix coefficients
